name: Agriculture-Vision: Aerial Farmland Pattern Analysis Benchmark
description: A pioneering large-scale aerial image database curated by the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (UIUC) and Syngenta. Contains 94,986 multi-spectral aerial image patches (512x512 pixels in RGB and near-infrared) harvested from high-resolution agricultural surveys across farmland throughout the United States. Densely annotated with pixel-level semantic masks across 9 distinct agricultural anomaly patterns including nutrient deficiency, waterlogging, weed cluster, and endrow.
